chunks: You pray to them, but they do not hear your call; and even if they heard you, they could not answer your prayer; and on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your having worshipped them. None can acquaint you (with the reality) as He who is informed of everything.
ai.seo_question: Why do false idols not hear our prayers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Fatir underscores the ontological deficiency of idols, which are merely created entities lacking the divine attribute of 'Sami' (All-Hearing) and 'Basir' (All-Seeing). The disownment on Judgment Day serves as a definitive refutation of polytheism, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid by demonstrating that only Allah, the Originator (Al-Bari'), possesses the authority to answer supplications and judge human deeds.
